text.title: 材料柜里的标签
text.situation:
材料柜装着标记样本和化学式卡片。水作为化合物出现；另一张卡说明氧化物含有与其他元素结合的氧。二氧化碳卡让人注意其分子式中的两个氧原子。再往前，黄色硫样本旁放着标记的硫化物样本。乔先读化学物质名称，再看颜色。工作人员提醒她们，chemical 指一种物质，并不自动意味着毒物。她们隔玻璃读标签，无须触碰柜内物品。

乔：这些化学物质都危险吗？
工作人员：这个词本身不能说明危险与否，每种物质都有自己的性质。
玛雅：这张卡写二氧化物。
工作人员：看看卡上的完整名称和化学式。

paragraphs.en: A materials case held labelled samples and formula cards. Water appeared as a compound, while a separate card explained that an oxide contains oxygen combined with another element. A carbon dioxide card drew attention to the two oxygen atoms in its molecular formula. Farther along, a yellow sulfur sample stood beside a labelled sulfide sample. Jo read the chemical names before looking at the colours. The attendant reminded them that a chemical is a substance, not a word that automatically means poison. They could read the labels through the glass without handling anything in the case.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Are all these chemicals dangerous?
Attendant: The word itself does not tell you that. Each substance has its own properties.
Maya: This card says dioxide.
Attendant: Look at the full name and formula on the card.

S04.G07.P01.function: Six labels inside a materials case
S04.G07.P01.cue: 描述化合物和氧化物卡。
acceptableAnswers: 水被标为化合物。 卡片说明氧化物包含什么。

S04.G07.P02.function: Six labels inside a materials case
S04.G07.P02.cue: 说明二氧化物名称和硫标签。
acceptableAnswers: 卡片把二氧化碳作为二氧化物的例子。 柜里放着黄色硫样本。

S04.G07.P03.function: Six labels inside a materials case
acceptableAnswers: 硫化物样本有独立标签。 每种化学物质有单独标签。

S04.G07.T01.function: Six labels inside a materials case
S04.G07.T01.cue: 标签标出一种物质，用名词chemical表达。
acceptableAnswers: 这种化学物质有自己的性质。
